title: Embedded - SME (Validation Automotive)
jobDescription: Job Summary: We are looking for a highly experienced Embedded Systems Subject Matter Expert (SME) specializing in Validation. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in HIL, SIL, and MIL validation, along with hands-on scripting and software testing skills. This role will focus on validating ADAS, Infotainment, BCM, and will prioritize ADAS and BMS/Electrification domains. Key Responsibilities: - Lead validation activities for embedded software systems across ADAS, Infotainment, Body Control Module (BCM), and BMS/Electrification. - Perform HIL, SIL, and MIL testing to ensure robust system performance and compliance. - Develop and execute automated test scripts using Python, CAPL, and C. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify issues, perform root cause analysis, and support resolution. - Ensure adherence to validation processes, standards, and industry best practices. - Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and validation teams. - Contribute to continuous improvement of test frameworks, automation, and validation methodologies. Required Skills & Experience: - 15-18 years of experience in Embedded Systems Validation. - Strong hands-on expertise in HIL testing, SIL testing, and MIL (good to have). - Proficiency in Python, CAPL, and C scripting for test automation. - Deep understanding and testing experience in ADAS (priority), BMS/Electrification (priority), Infotainment, and BCM. - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. - Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities. Preferred Qualifications: - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, or related field. - Experience working with automotive OEMs or Tier-1 suppliers. - Knowledge of automotive standards and processes (ASPICE, ISO 26262, etc.) is a plus. Please send your resumes to ketaki_karanjkar@onwardgroup.com mentioning the Job Title in the subject.

title: Embedded - Software Architect (ADAS, Infotainment_ Automotive)
jobDescription: Role Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Embedded Software Architect (SME) with deep expertise in ADAS, Infotainment, and Automotive Embedded platforms. The SME will lead the architecture, development, optimization, and integration of complex embedded solutions. This role will drive technical excellence, mentor engineering teams, solve high-impact technical challenges, and ensure alignment with global automotive standards and best practices. Key Responsibilities: - Provide expert-level guidance in embedded system design, architecture, development, and integration. - Define technical strategies, system requirements, and solution roadmaps for complex embedded products. - Lead troubleshooting and performance optimization efforts across hardware-software interfaces. - Review and validate embedded software for compliance with coding standards and industry certifications. - Mentor and support engineering teams on embedded development best practices and processes. - Engage with clients and internal stakeholders to clarify technical requirements and deliver robust solutions. - Stay up to date on emerging technologies in embedded systems, IoT, real-time systems, and microcontroller platforms. Technical Skills & Requirements: - Proficient in embedded C/C++, RTOS, Linux, or bare-metal programming. - Strong knowledge of microcontrollers (ARM, AVR, PIC, etc.) and peripheral interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, ADC, PWM). - Experience with firmware development, bootloaders, low-level drivers, and hardware abstraction layers (HAL). - Familiarity with debugging tools such as JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, etc. - Experience with version control and CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, etc.) - Exposure to model-based development (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink) is a plus. - Understanding safety standards like ISO 26262, IEC 61508, or MISRA C (as per domain). - Proficiency in system-level debugging and performance profiling. Qualifications: - Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or related field. - 10+ years of hands-on experience in embedded system design and development. - Prior experience in leading technical teams or acting as a consultant on embedded projects. Please send your resumes to ketaki_karanjkar@onwardgroup.com mentioning the Job Title in the subject.

title: Global Delivery Leader - Automotive Digital
jobDescription: Role Summary: We are seeking a seasoned Delivery Leader - Automotive Digital Solutions to spearhead global delivery operations across the USA, EU and India. The ideal candidate will create customized solutions within the digital space for clients, drive large-scale digital transformation programs, ensuring excellence in delivery, innovation, and client engagement. The role combines digital delivery leadership, strategic client partnerships, and business growth, with frequent international travel to strengthen relationships and accelerate account expansion. Key Responsibilities: - Lead end-to-end delivery of Automotive Digital programs across connected vehicle, cloud, analytics, and software platforms. - Manage large offshore delivery teams (500+ engineers) ensuring quality, cost, and time efficiency. - Build and sustain strong relationships with global OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers across USA & EU. - Drive digital innovation initiatives in areas like SDV (Software-Defined Vehicles), AI/ML, data analytics, cloud-native applications, and mobility ecosystems. - Collaborate with sales and account management to identify, mine, and expand opportunities in digital programs. - Partner with technology practices to establish reusable accelerators, frameworks, and best practices. - Govern delivery excellence through Agile/SAFe frameworks and data-driven performance dashboards. - Support RFPs, proposals, and transformation roadmaps for digital engagements. - Foster a high-performance culture through mentoring, upskilling, and governance. - Act as an escalation and transformation leader, ensuring client satisfaction and proactive risk mitigation. - Be visa-ready and travel frequently to USA/EU for client governance and business development. Required Skills & Experience: - 18-20 years of experience in digital delivery preferably for the automotive or mobility sector, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles. - Proven experience managing large-scale digital transformation programs (cloud, data, AI/ML, mobility, connected services). - Strong connects with OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers in the USA and EU. - Deep understanding of software-defined vehicle (SDV) ecosystems, digital twin, DevOps, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and analytics. - Expertise in global delivery models, digital governance frameworks, and Agile/SAFe methodologies. - Demonstrated success in client relationship management, account growth, and delivery transformation. - Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-cultural collaboration skills. - Educational qualification: B.E/B.Tech; MBA or Management degree preferred. Please send your resumes to ketaki_karanjkar@onwardgroup.com mentioning the Job Title in the subject.
